title: Show bed: light
description: Swung pizzicato in quarter notes (eighths in bars 16-21), a two-feel bass, soft taps and quarter-note hats; the major motif (F F C B A) on vibes every 8 bars.
usage: The motif version: for intros, outros and gaps between lines. Under speech prefer the -underscore version. Loops seamlessly (sample 0 to the end). -26 LUFS-S with a voice pocket at 1.25-2 kHz: duck it under Zoo's narration with scripts/audio/duck.py (the band-split duck, its default). Same tempo and key family as the other show beds: cross-fade between them on a bar line (every 2.667 s).
selfReview: Pizzicato, a two-feel bass, soft taps and hats, with the major motif on vibes every 8 bars (the lydian B is the wink). Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): it was the busiest masker in the set, so the pizzicato plays quarter notes (8ths only in bars 16-21) 3 dB lower, the hats play quarters and the claps are gone. Under Zoo with the band-split duck its index is 0.83 (0.72 before, with the broadband duck), and the onsets that come within 15 dB of his voice in 1-4 kHz fell from about 147 to 82 a minute. Its share of 1-4 kHz modulation at syllable rate is still the highest of the beds (0.45, was 0.53): if it still reads as a stock 'quirky explainer' after a listen, re-arrange it on brushes, walking bass and vibes comping, keeping tempo, key and form. The -underscore version mutes the motif and lead lines; use it under speech.
